name: ballot-box
description: A ballot-box identity for vti-voting-service, the host service that holds community elections' ballot boxes and boards (VTI-VOT-001 – 100). Public by design and never a community's own: communities name it as `ballotBox` in their manifests, and its signature on a receipt or a board head is the evidence voters and auditors hold, so it is its own did:webvh and never its operator VTA's (VTI-KEY-007). Declares an Ed25519 key (#key-0) that is both authentication (it answers Trust Tasks) and assertionMethod (it signs receipts and heads), and an X25519 key-agreement key (#key-1). Reachable over TSP and DIDComm through the mediator named by MEDIATOR_DID — both services name the same mediator, TSP first (canonical order) — which is how a community registers, closes and cancels its elections and how communities and auditors read boards. Also advertises `TrustTaskHTTPS` at HTTPS_URL, because a cast MUST be accepted over a binding whose sender holds no persistent identifier and no session (VTI-VOT-004): a voter casts from a key made for that cast alone, which has no mediator session to receive its receipt on, and opening one would give the mediator an account, a relationship record, and the voter's address and timing. A client POSTs to `<HTTPS_URL>/trust-tasks` (HTTPS binding 0.2 §6). URL or WEBVH_SERVER is still required at provision time so the VTA knows where to publish the did:webvh log.
